# netbox_virtual_chassis (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox virtual chassis (`/api/dcim/virtual-chassis/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_chassis" "stack1" {
  name = "dc1-stack01"
}
output "stack_master" {
  value = data.netbox_virtual_chassis.stack1.master_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/virtual-chassis/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `domain` (String) Domain. Defaults to an empty string.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `master_id` (Number) ID of the Device (`netbox_device`).
- `member_count` (Number) Member Count.
- `member_ids` (Set of Number) Members. References `netbox_device`.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
